g.text: GPU nodes are Ubuntu VMs, not switches.
RoCE study focus uses Ethernet fabric behavior in EVE-NG.
InfiniBand concepts remain workbook-guided, not fully emulated.
Anycast gateways live on MLAG leaf pairs and border pair.
Spines do not host tenant SVIs.
Use these tables as the source of truth for physical mapping.
Topology center is intentionally uncluttered for readability.
Use the workbook for config, validation, and troubleshooting tasks.
